bugs_found: loan_payment does not validate/cast months as an integer, so float/string/Decimal inputs can cause TypeError or fractional exponents instead of a controlled validation failure
compound_interest silently truncates years and compounds_per_year via int(), changing inputs like 1.9 years or 12.7 compounds/year without error
transfer uses amount without Decimal coercion or finite/type validation, so float amounts can raise TypeError and NaN/Infinity-like Decimal values are not explicitly rejected
transfer is not atomic if crediting account_to fails after debiting account_from, leaving balances inconsistent
apply_fee can return a negative net amount when fee_min exceeds amount, silently turning a small charge into a negative payout
fx_convert does not validate rate positivity or finiteness, allowing zero/negative/NaN/Infinity FX rates to produce invalid conversions
money functions do not enforce currency precision/rounding, allowing sub-cent balances and unbounded Decimal precision to leak into receipts/payments
